verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-meem-raa tilka aayaatul-kitaabi wal-ladhee unzila ilayka min rabbikal-haqqu wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon

Allaahul-ladhee rafa'as-samaawaati bighayri amadin tarawnahaa thumma istawaa alal-arshi wa sakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajree li'jalin musamman yudabbirul-amra yufassilul-aayaati la-allakum biliqaa'i rabbikum tooqinoon

Wa huwal-ladhee maddal-arda wa ja'ala feehaa rawaasiya wa anhaaran wa min kullith-thamaraati ja'ala feehaa zawjayni ithnayni yughshil-laylan-nahaara inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin yatafakkaroon

Wa fil-ardi qita'un mutajaawiraatun wa jannaatun min a'naabin wa zar'un wa nakheelun sinwaanun wa ghayru sinwaanin yusqaa bimaa'in waahidin wa nufaddilu ba'dahaa alaa ba'din fil-ukuli inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin ya'qiloon

Wa in ta'jab fa-ajabun qawluhum a'idhaa kunnaa turaaban a'innaa lafee khalqin jadeedin ulaa'ikal-ladheena kafaroo birabbihim wa ulaa'ikal-aghlaalu fee a'naaqihim wa ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari hum feehaa khaalidoon
Wa yasta'jiloonaka bis-sayyi'ati qablal-hasanati wa qad khalat min qablihimul-mathulaatu wa inna rabbaka ladhoo maghfiratin lin-naasi alaa zulmihim wa inna rabbaka lashadeedul-iqaab
Wa yaqoolul-ladheena kafaroo lawlaa unzila alayhi aayatun min rabbihi innamaa anta mundhirun wa likulli qawmin haad
Allaahu ya'lamu maa tahmilu kullu unthaa wa maa tagheedul-arhaamu wa maa tazdaadu wa kullu shay'in indahu bimiqdaar
Aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadatil-kabeerul-muta'aalee
Sawaa'un minkum man asarral-qawla wa man jahara bihi wa man huwa mustakhfin bil-layli wa saaribun bin-nahaar

Lahu mu'aqqibaatun min bayni yadayhi wa min khalfihi yahfazoonahu min amrillaahi innallaaha laa yughayyiru maa biqawmin hattaa yughayyiroo maa bi-anfusihim wa idhaa araada Allaahu biqawmin soo'an falaa maradda lahu wa maa lahum min doonihi min waal
Huwal-ladhee yureekumul-barqa khawfan wa tama'an wa yunshi'us-sahaabath-thiqaal
Wa yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-malaa'ikatu min kheefatihi wa yursilus-sawaa'iqa fayuseebu bihaa man yashaa'u wa hum yujaadiloona fee Allaahi wa huwa shadeedul-mihaal

Lahu da'watul-haqqi wal-ladheena yad'oona min doonihi laa yastajeeboona lahum bishay'in illaa kabaasiti kaffayhi ilal-maa'i liyablugha faahu wa maa huwa bibaalighihi wa maa du'aa'ul-kaafireena illaa fee dalaal
Wa Lillaahi yasjudu man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi taw'an wa karhan wa zilaaluhum bil-ghuduwwi wal-aasaal

Qul man rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi quli Allaahu qul afaattakhadhtum min doonihi awliyaa'a laa yamlikoona li'nfusihim naf'an wa laa darran qul hal yastawil-a'maa wal-baseeru am hal tastawiz-zulumaatu wan-noor am ja'aloo Lillaahi shurakaa'a khalaqoo kakhalqihi fatashaabahal-khalqu alayhim quli Allaahu khaaliqu kulli shay'in wa huwal-waahidul-qahhaar

Anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fasaalat awdiyatun biqadarihaa fahtamalas-saylu zabadan raabeean wa mimmaa yooqidoona alayhi fin-naari ibtighaa'a hilyatin aw mataa'in zabadun mithluhu kadhaalika yadribu Allaahul-haqqa wal-baatila fa-ammaz-zabadu fayadhhabu jufaa'an wa ammaa maa yanfa'un-naasa fayamkuthu fil-ardi kadhaalika yadribu Allaahul-amthaal

Lilladheena istajaaboo lirabbihimul-husnaa wal-ladheena lam yastajeeboo lahu law anna lahum maa fil-ardi jamee'an wa mithlahu ma'ahu laftadaw bihi ulaa'ika lahum soo'ul-hisaabi wa ma'waahum jahannamu wa bi'sal-mihaad
Afaman ya'lamu annamaa unzila ilayka min rabbikal-haqqu kaman huwa a'maa innamaa yatadhakkaru ulul-albaab
Al-ladheena yoofoona bi-ahdi Allaahi wa laa yanqudoonal-meethaaq
Wal-ladheena yasiloona maa amara Allaahu bihi an yoosala wa yakhshawna rabbahum wa yakhaafoona soo'al-hisaab
Wal-ladheena sabaroo ibtighaa'a wajhi rabbihim wa aqaamus-salaata wa anfaqoo mimmaa razaqnaahum sirran wa alaaniyatan wa yadra'oona bil-hasanatis-sayyi'ata ulaa'ika lahum uqbad-daar
Jannaatu adnin yadkhuloonahaa wa man salaha min aabaa'ihim wa azwaajihim wa dhurriyyaatihim wal-malaa'ikatu yadkhuloona alayhim min kulli baab
Salaamun alaykum bimaa sabartum fani'ma uqbad-daar
Wal-ladheena yanqudoona ahda Allaahi min ba'di meethaaqihi wa yaqta'oona maa amara Allaahu bihi an yoosala wa yufsidoona fil-ardi ulaa'ika lahumul-la'natu wa lahum soo'ud-daar
Allaahu yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u wa yaqdiru wa farihoo bil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa mal-hayaatud-dunyaa fil-aakhirati illaa mataa
Wa yaqoolul-ladheena kafaroo lawlaa unzila alayhi aayatun min rabbihi qul innallaaha yudillu man yashaa'u wa yahdee ilayhi man anaab
Al-ladheena aamanoo wa tatma'innu quloobuhum bidhikri Allaahi alaa bidhikri Allaahi tatma'innul-quloob
Al-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati toobaa lahum wa husnu ma'aab

Kadhaalika arsalnaaka fee ummatin qad khalat min qablihaa umamun litatluwa alayhimul-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka wa hum yakfuroona bir-rahmani qul huwa rabbee laa ilaaha illaa huwa alayhi tawakkaltu wa ilayhi mataab

Wa law anna qur'aanan suyyirat bihil-jibaalu aw qutti'at bihil-ardu aw kullima bihil-mawtaa bal Lillaahil-amru jamee'an afalam yay'asil-ladheena aamanoo an law yashaa'u Allaahu lahadan-naasa jamee'an wa laa yazaalul-ladheena kafaroo tuseebuhum bimaa sana'oo qaari'atun aw tahullu qareeban min daarihim hattaa ya'tiya wa'du Allaahi innallaaha laa yukhliful-mee'aad
Wa laqadi ustuhzi'a birusulin min qablika fa-amlaytu lilladheena kafaroo thumma akhadhtuhum fakayfa kaana iqaab

Afaman huwa qaa'imun alaa kulli nafsin bimaa kasabat wa ja'aloo Lillaahi shurakaa'a qul sammoohum am tunabbi'oonahu bimaa laa ya'lamu fil-ardi am bizaahirin minal-qawli bal zuyyina lilladheena kafaroo makruhum wa suddoo anis-sabeeli wa man yudlili Allaahu famaa lahu min haad
Lahum adhaabun fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa la-adhaabul-aakhirati ashaqqu wa maa lahum mina Allaahi min waaq
Mathalul-jannatil-latee wu'idal-muttaqoona tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru ukuluhaa daa'imun wa zilluhaa tilka uqbal-ladheena ittaqaw wa uqbal-kaafireenan-naar
Wal-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba yafrahoona bimaa unzila ilayka wa minal-ahzaabi man yunkiru ba'dahu qul innamaa umirtu an a'buda Allaaha wa laa ushrika bihi ilayhi ad'oo wa ilayhi ma'aab
Wa kadhalika anzalnaahu hukman arabiyyan wa la-ini ittaba'ta ahwaa'ahum ba'damaa jaa'aka minal-ilmi maa laka mina Allaahi min waliyyin wa laa waaq
Wa laqad arsalnaa rusulan min qablika wa ja'alnaa lahum azwaajan wa dhurriyyatan wa maa kaana lirasoolin an ya'tiya bi-aayatin illaa bi-idhni Allaahi likulli ajalin kitaab
Yamhoo Allaahu maa yashaa'u wa yuthbitu wa indahu ummul-kitaab
Wa in maa nuriyannaka ba'dal-ladhee na'iduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-innamaa alaykal-balaaghu wa alaynal-hisaab
Awalam yaraw annaa na'til-arda nanqusuhaa min atraafihaa Wallaahu yahkumu laa mu'aqqiba lihukmihi wa huwa saree'ul-hisaab
Wa qad makaral-ladheena min qablihim falillaahil-makru jamee'an ya'lamu maa taksibu kullu nafsin wa saya'lamul-kuffaaru liman uqbad-daar
Wa yaqoolul-ladheena kafaroo lasta mursalan qul kafaa Billaahi shaheedan baynee wa baynakum wa man indahu ilmul-kitaab
